mapper.select: select sp.name as plan_name, us.status, us.current_period_start, us.current_period_end, us.cancel_at_period_end from user_subscriptions us join subscription_plans sp on sp.id = us.plan_id where us.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) order by us.current_period_end desc limit 1
select id::text as id, amount, currency, status, paid_at, provider, provider_order_id from billing_transactions where user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) order by created_at desc
